name: API Orchestrator - Alerts
description: Threshold-based alert rules (error rate, average duration, no-requests, success-rate drop) with cooldowns and multi-channel notifications (Slack, Discord).
project_description: API Orchestrator - Alerts adds threshold-based alerting on top of API Orchestrator request logs. Define api_orchestrator_alert config entities that evaluate a metric (error rate, average duration, no-requests, success-rate drop) against a threshold over a time window, with per-alert severity, cooldown, and optional service/endpoint scoping. On cron the AlertMonitoringService evaluates active alerts and dispatches to the built-in Drupal log plus pluggable AlertChannel plugins (Slack and Discord webhooks ship in-box). Requires api_orchestrator. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
